Hello,

Thanks for reaching out, and we appreciate the years you've been renting with us. I've looked into the €300 charge on RB-20263103. Damage charges are assessed against our standard repair-cost schedule, and once that assessment has been applied and communicated, the charge is final - it isn't something we can renegotiate or waive afterwards, including for long-standing accounts like yours. That holds regardless of how the wear is characterised.

If you believe the damage was actually there before the rental started, let us know and we can check that against the check-out photographs and our pre-rental inspection record - that's the one situation where a charge wouldn't apply.

Best regards,
Customer Service

reply_body:
Hello,

I want to clear up a misunderstanding here. The damage deposit is fully refundable only if the equipment comes back undamaged and complete - it isn't refundable regardless of condition. Where damage is found, we assess it against our standard repair-cost schedule and deduct that amount from the deposit; if the damage is serious enough (beyond normal wear, missing accessories, or a very late return), the full deposit can be forfeited.

The amount withheld on your recent return reflects the damage found at check-in, assessed in the usual way. If you'd like the details of exactly what was assessed, let me know and I'll send them over.

Best regards,
Customer Service
Haapaharju Oy
